name: Steele Bancorp Inc.
summary: Steele Bancorp Inc., a holding company based in Mifflinburg, Pennsylvania, oversees Mifflinburg Bank and Trust Company, delivering a comprehensive suite of financial services throughout the state. The company facilitates various deposit options, including checking, savings, sweep, and health savings accounts, alongside certificates of deposit. Its lending portfolio spans commercial, mortgage, and residential real estate, as well as consumer financing with offerings like home, personal, auto, medical/professional, farm/agricultural, and nonprofit business loans. Clients can also access lines of credit, overdraft services, and credit cards, all supported by convenient online and mobile banking platforms. Beyond core banking, Steele Bancorp Inc. extends its services to include merchant cards, lock box processing, remote deposit, CD file storage, safe and night deposit boxes, automatic transfers, notary services, e-statements (with check images), consolidated statements, stop payment orders, and wire transfers. Furthermore, it offers diverse investment products comprising retirement planning, college funding, life insurance, brokerage, and investment analysis. For businesses, the company provides specialized solutions such as IRAs, 401(k)s, pensions, profit-sharing plans, SEPs, and defined contribution plans. Established in 1872, the company, formerly known as Mifflinburg Bancorp, Inc., is scheduled to officially adopt the name Steele Bancorp Inc. in August 2025.
